user_goals: expand recommendations into strict TDD enforcement for AI agents
use strict text pattern validation in PR body instead of committing evidence files
apply changes now, then invoke ai-gen-history, then commit and push
starting_state: AGENTS.md had architecture and coverage guidance but no strict mandatory Red/Green/Refactor contract
CI workflow only ran Go CI checks and did not validate PR TDD evidence
repository had no pull request template
collaboration_timeline: user asked what to add to AGENTS.md for TDD flow
discussion expanded to stronger enforcement and CI options without repository file bloat
user selected strict text pattern approach
AI added policy sections, PR template, validator script, and CI gate wiring
user requested ai-gen-history invocation followed by commit and push

decisions.decision: enforce TDD evidence via PR body structure check
decisions.rationale: provides merge gate without adding committed evidence files for every feature
decisions.impact: PRs missing required TDD evidence format fail quickly

decisions.decision: make validator section-aware and strict about placeholders
decisions.rationale: avoid weak evidence and prevent ambiguity with repeated field names
decisions.impact: higher consistency and clearer reviewer expectations

decisions.decision: run evidence gate only on pull_request events
decisions.rationale: push workflows do not have PR body context
decisions.impact: maintains existing CI behavior on push while enforcing PR quality gate

behavior_changes: AGENTS.md now includes mandatory TDD compliance contract, evidence requirements, forbidden actions, exception protocol, and strict done criteria
pull request template now enforces structured Red/Green/Refactor and final verification entries
CI includes a pull-request-only TDD evidence job that validates PR body format and values before Go CI job

verification.result: failed as expected when PR_BODY was empty
passed with complete required sections and fields
showed expected modified and added files

risks_tradeoffs: strict formatting checks can reject valid evidence written in non-template style
authors may experience initial friction while adapting to mandatory template
validator confirms declared evidence structure, not objective truth of test execution
session_knowledge: TDD compliance in AI workflows works best with policy + template + CI gate aligned to same required fields
PR-body enforcement gives strong process control without repository evidence-file sprawl
section-scoped regex checks are safer than global field scans when field labels repeat across sections
for this repository, ai-gen-history outputs should be paired timestamped md/json files in ai-gen-history/
next_steps: optionally add semantic heuristics to validator for fail/pass tokens
document one complete PR example using the new template to reduce adoption friction
